title: Actual Q3 four-context D-weighted energy transfer audit
question: Do the actual finite Q3 histories satisfy the corrected four-context D-weighted transfer inequality, and do its cross terms show a volume/beta-uniform pattern or a route-local growth signal?

model.interpretation: The finite context inequality is exact; uniformity of A,B,C,D for actual Q3 common-core histories is not inferred from finite rows.

adversarial_review.check: A,B,C,D are computed from the same H eigenbasis with p_i and p_j positions retained; no transpose symmetry is assumed for D.
The equal-probability diagonal limit and arithmetic-mean inequality are checked for every actual finite Gibbs spectrum.
Only differences enter S, while all four contexts use the declared positive shifted energies.
No unweighted M2-times-norm replacement is used after EXP-001144; the four contexts are retained explicitly.
Finite context ratios and volume trends are diagnostics only; no common-core uniformity is inferred.
Direct Cauchy, modular transfer, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks the rational termwise context inequality and constants; actual spectral matrix rows are independently executed in Python.

qft_interface.closed: The corrected finite interface is evaluated on the actual Q3 histories without discarding energy-index orientation.
qft_interface.open: Uniform local bounds for all four contexts or direct D,delta-D Cauchy on a common core, modular transfer, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Finite four-context audit only; no thermodynamic QFT theorem or common-alpha closure.

no_overclaim: Finite context inequalities and row metrics do not prove a uniform Q3 common-core estimate. The route remains open unless a volume/source/beta-uniform bound is established or a certified growth obstruction is found.
